title: A pro-etale covering of a w-contractible affine has a section
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $T=\operatorname{Spec}A$ the affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum] [def-pc-scheme], in the universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose every faithfully flat weakly etale ring map $A\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] admits a ring homomorphism $r:B\to A$ with $r\circ(A\to B)=\mathrm{id}_A$. For every pro-etale covering family $\{f_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering] indexed within these universes, let $p:\coprod_{i\in I}T_i\to T$ be the morphism induced by the $f_i$ from the scheme coproduct [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Then there is a morphism of schemes $\sigma:T\to\coprod_{i\in I}T_i$ such that $p\circ\sigma=\mathrm{id}_T$.
